## Interfaces

### RunIo

How the child is started, and how Windows takes its tree down; the real ones unless a test hands in its own.

```ts
interface RunIo {
    spawn?: (command: string, args: readonly string[], options: SpawnOptions) => ChildProcess;
    spawnSync?: (command: string, args: readonly string[], options: {
        stdio: 'ignore';
    }) => unknown;
}
```

## Types

### RunArgs

The command line, read: dotenv's flags up to the command, and the command with everything after it.

```ts
type RunArgs = {
    help: true;
} | {
    error: string;
} | {
    paths: string[];
    pathSet: boolean;
    quiet?: boolean;
    debug?: boolean;
    override?: boolean;
    fast?: boolean;
    command: string[];
};
```
